test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

Spanish person are well known worldwide / for their warm hospitality / and food.

options.text: Spanish person are well known worldwide

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 – "Spanish person are well known worldwide"**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in subject-verb agreement and noun number consistency.
 
• The noun **"person"** is singular, but the verb **"are"** is plural, creating a mismatch.
 
• To correct this, either the noun should be made plural (“**people**”) or the verb should be singular (“**is**”).
 
• Since the statement refers to Spanish people in general, the correct subject should be plural: **"Spanish people are well known worldwide."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Spanish people are well known worldwide for their warm hospitality and food."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When referring to a group or nationality in general, use the plural form like "**Spanish people**," "**French citizens**," etc.
 
• Ensure subject-verb agreement: plural subjects take plural verbs and vice versa.
